episode_summary: In this episode, Bill Melnick shares his journey from a corporate career at Ralph Lauren to becoming a top luxury real estate agent. He discusses the importance of marketing properties as a lifestyle, the challenges of pricing high-end estates, and the role of personal branding and social media in real estate. Bill also highlights the limitations of AI in maintaining personal connections with clients.
